user.title: Alvuna
user.description: Alvuna puts your Home Assistant on the TV, laid out by itself from your areas and devices.

pair.title: Pair a TV
pair.description: A TV is asking to show Alvuna. Type the code it shows on screen. It gets its own Home Assistant user, not an administrator.

data_description.code: Six characters, as shown on the TV.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, e.g. Living room TV.
data_description.local_only: Turn off for a TV in another home that reaches this Home Assistant over the internet.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing request expired. Open Alvuna on the TV again for a new code.
abort.too_many_tries: Too many wrong codes. Open Alvuna on the TV again for a new one.

error.wrong_code: That is not the code on the TV.

create_entry.default: Alvuna is ready. Open the Alvuna app on your TV (or this Home Assistant's address followed by /alvuna/tv/ in the TV's browser): it shows a code to type under Discovered. The Alvuna panel in the sidebar adjusts what the TV shows.

init.title: Alvuna
init.description: What shows where is changed in the Alvuna panel in the sidebar. Here only the weather and the TV timers.

data_description.weather: Leave empty to use the first weather entity.
data_description.tv_screensaver_minutes: Minutes without a key press. 0 turns it off.
data_description.tv_idle_minutes: Minutes without a key press. 0 keeps it open.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a message on paired TVs running Alvuna.

device_id.name: TVs
device_id.description: Leave empty for every paired TV.

show_camera.name: Show a camera
show_camera.description: Opens a camera full screen on paired TVs running Alvuna.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long before it closes by itself.

device_id.name: TVs
device_id.description: Leave empty for every paired TV.

not_a_tv.message: Device {device_id} is not a TV paired with Alvuna.
